description: For a quantifier-free relational formula \(\varphi\), the computed positive disjunctive normal form is equivalent to \(\varphi\), and the negative normal form is equivalent to \(\neg\varphi\), at every assignment.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.normalForm_correct.{u} {o : Bool} {n : ℕ} {M : Type u}
  (r : M → M → Prop) (φ : Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.RelFormula o n)
  (hφ : Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Formula.IsQF φ) (b : Bool) (x : Fin n → M) :
  Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize r
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.dnfFormula
        (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.EffectiveQuantifierElimination.normalForm φ b))
      x ↔
    if b = true then Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize r φ x
    else ¬Lemmatheca.ModelTheory.QuantifierElimination.Formula.Realize r φ x
